title: ship: ignore goals closed before ship was enabled, never roll back a merge ship did not make, gate in wt/, V4
spec:
Evidence (orchestrator repo, 2026-10-07 ~01:00-03:10, scratchpad daemon log): with [ship].enabled=true, ship.candidates()
(orchestrator/ship.py:411) returned every goal with result.goal_closed and no ship state, including T-0988, T-1375, T-1383,
T-1388 whose PRs 24/30/31/32 the human merged 2026-09-23/24. advance() found them already in main, ran the post-merge gate
on today's main, got red, and called rollback: PR 45 (revert of PR 30) opened, the others hit revert conflicts. Task files:
.orchestrator/tasks/T-1375.json pipeline.ship holds the full record.

Fix, in orchestrator/ship.py:
A1 Persist ship_enabled_at the first time tick() sees [ship].enabled true (state file .orchestrator/ship_state.json; delete
   it when ship is seen disabled, so off-then-on starts a new window). candidates() returns only goals whose close time
   (pipeline.closed_at, else the goal_closed event time, else updated_at) is >= ship_enabled_at. Goals closed earlier are
   never touched and get no ship state written.
A2 Automatic rollback only for a merge this ship performed: pipeline.ship records merged_by="ship" when ship itself
   merges the PR. A goal found already merged into target (merged by a human or another path) is recorded
   state="shipped" with merged_by="external" and gets NO post-merge rollback; a red post-merge gate on it only notifies.
   `orchestrator rollback <sha>` run by a human is unchanged.
A3 Ship gate worktrees live at <root>/wt/ship-<name> (same depth as task worktrees wt/T-xxxx), not .orchestrator/ship-wt.
   Several tests derive the repo root from Path(__file__).parents[3] (tests/test_overhead.py:43), which is wrong at
   .orchestrator/ship-wt/<name>/tests and made every post-merge gate red. Also make test_overhead.test_report_over_real_run_rows
   find the repository with `git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir` (parent of the common .git) and skip
   when that has no .orchestrator/runs rows, so it no longer depends on worktree depth.
A4 (V4) ship.py ~368: the reset to gating when a merged PR no longer covers the goal keeps the old post_merge_gate and
   merge_sha; clear both in that update.
Tests (tests/test_ship.py): test_goals_closed_before_enable_are_ignored, test_disable_resets_enabled_at,
test_externally_merged_goal_never_rolled_back, test_ship_worktree_under_wt, test_reset_to_gating_clears_post_merge_state;
tests/test_overhead.py passes when run from a worktree at any depth.
Run: PYTHONPATH=tests uv run python -m unittest tests.test_ship tests.test_overhead. Commit on the task branch.
acceptance: A1-A4 each have their named test and it passes
